$comment: Merged over vscode/product.json by scripts/bootstrap.sh (deep merge, these keys win). Keep this list tight and reviewed — every field here is a divergence from upstream Code-OSS we have to carry across version bumps.
$theme_note: The default colour theme is Valyria Dark. It is enforced in two places, NOT here: (1) theme/ (the code-free valyria-theme built-in) contributes.configurationDefaults; (2) build/patches/010-valyria-default-theme.patch rewrites ThemeSettingDefaults. product.json has no key for this — `initialColorTheme` is read only by the browser workbench (environmentService.options), so it is dead on desktop; the cold-start pre-paint is handled by build/patches/011-theme-default-hardening.patch.
$telemetry_note: No telemetry, ever (PLAN.md §32). These keys are cleared so no endpoint is even resolvable; the offline job (scripts/verify-offline.sh) enforces it.
$gallery_note: Open VSX, not the Microsoft Marketplace (licence + trademark). Swap for a self-hosted gallery later if desired.
$updates_note: Pointed at our own release feed in scripts/build.sh; left empty here so a dev build never phones home.
